score_definition: per (model,task): main_score averaged over entries of the first available split in [test,validation,dev,train] (all languages/subsets); model revision dir = the one with most task files (ties: lexicographically greatest)
normalization: NFKC, lowercase, strip org prefix (before __), strip trailing quantization tokens; family key strips trailing size/variant/version tokens; content hash = sha256 of canonical JSON {task: round(main_score,6)} over the model's full record (before column filtering); union-find over family keys, content hashes and normalized names; groups hash-assigned (sha256 order) to planes and to history/held-out (first groups in hash order until >=25% of rows)
